$comment: Rectangles are in logical 270x480 engine pixels (9:16, the 1080x1920 output at *4). Every important text element (subtitles, the source and title plates, the AI line, the cover title) must stay inside common_safe_rect; `studio template validate` checks it.
sourcing_note: Checked 2026-10-29. The platforms publish safe zones only for ads, not for organic posts; the per-platform rectangles below are those ad zones (1080x1920 px / 4). Ads reserve more than organic posts: a call-to-action and ad label sit in the bottom band. Sources: TikTok Ads Help, In-Feed ads, and its safe-zone overlay file (https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/tiktok-auction-in-feed-ads, page last updated June 2026; the overlay is drawn on 720x1280 and scaled x1.5); Google Ads Help, vertical video safe zones (https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/9128498) and its overlay PNG; Meta ads guide, Instagram Reels (https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/update/video/instagram-reels: at least 14% top, 35% bottom, 6% each side). Secondary creator tools disagree with TikTok's own file (e.g. top 130 or 160 px, bottom 480 px).

tiktok.source: TikTok In-Feed ads overlay: margins 240 top / 660 bottom / 120 left / 120 right px; the right-hand button column is x 780-960 px from y 840 px down (logical x >= 195 from y >= 210).

youtube.source: Google Ads vertical video safe zone (in-feed, in-stream, Shorts ads): margins 288 top / 672 bottom / 48 left / 192 right px.

instagram.source: Meta ads guide, Reels: 14% top / 35% bottom / 6% each side (about 269 / 672 / 65 / 65 px); no button-column size published.

ads_common_rect_note: Intersection of the ad zones above, minus TikTok's button column: what a template made for paid placement would have to use.
common_safe_rect_note: The working area for organic posts (owner's choice, 2026-10-29: plates, subtitles and the AI line centered in the frame). Organic posts have no ad call-to-action, so text runs below the ads' bottom margin, down to logical y 400 (1600 px), above the username/caption/music band, and from y 36 (144 px), below the status bar and the TikTok tabs. Known cost: on TikTok the right end of a long subtitle line and of the AI line can reach under the button column (x >= 195 from y 210); centering is impossible without it. Paid placement would need a template inside ads_common_rect.
